source: rainy-canal-space-06.blend; SPACE07 remains the appearance and layout comparison
userTarget: The two coarse backland buildings in the user-marked red box, together with whole-neighbourhood building layout and ground connections.
changes: Grouped the detached additions as short attached rows, with actual corner side entrances and shared-wall roof treatment.
Replaced four simplified background masses with four-sided buildings. The red-box pair now addresses the south street and a shared forecourt.
Added continuous frontage paving, defined private garden boundaries, corner approaches and terrain shoulders.
Raised only six rear service entrances to their actual local sloping ground; principal and secondary public entrances remain on the shared street level.
Added a gentle south-west approach ramp without changing old terrain, and removed mistakenly river-facing shoulder strips.
Derived windows and lamps from explicit new facade/entrance coordinates, including low-roof lamp clearance.

independentChecks.knownOriginalStepEdgeSamples: Seven 8cm ankle rays hit original bookshop step edges, reproduced identically against the original source and explicitly retained in the physical report.

browserChecks.courtRoaming: Observed entry into the new shared forecourt, followed by return to south residential street and automatic handoff to walking mode.
browserChecks.previewResources: Closed the six agent-created SPACE02–07 preview tabs after identifying competing render load. All version files and the built-in SPACE07 comparison remain available; SPACE08 stays open.
browserChecks.comparison: 07 original layout and 08 recomposition use the same camera and shared sky/exposure treatment; baseline walking is disabled because geometry differs.
browserChecks.startupObservation: An initial WebGL program validation failure produced a white scene. A reload restored rendering; shader compilation can temporarily block browser inspection. No success claim relies on the rejected white capture.

limits: This revision validates street grouping, entrance access, building massing and frontage connections. It is not a claim of reference-photo-level environment art.
Vegetation, distant landscape and material detail still need a coherent later visual pass.
House interiors and closed private gardens are not walkable. Navigation is bounded swept proxies, not a full rigid-body physics system.
